jurisdiction.venue: SEBI, SAT, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & SFIO

headline: Before Shareholders Heard About a $230 Million Hole, Bank Chiefs Found Time to Sell, SEBI Alleges
deck: SEBI froze ₹19.78 crore ($2.3M) from five former IndusInd Bank leaders accused of unloading stock before disclosing a ₹2,000 crore derivatives hole.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Executive resignations, ESOP clawbacks, and ₹19.78 Cr frozen under SEBI’s May 2025 interim order; SAT appeals and SFIO inquiries active.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: If proven, the conduct SEBI alleges would resemble selling a wrecked car for $1,800 after hiding an inspection report
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Immediate consumer-fraud charges without multi-year appellate stays

sources.title: SEBI Interim Order in the Matter of Insider Trading in the Scrip of IndusInd Bank Ltd.
sources.agency: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

interactive_art_spec.caption: Bandra Kurla Complex in Mumbai. IndusInd Bank shares plunged 27% when the ₹2,000 crore derivatives shortfall finally reached the public.
